public.title: Drizzle Query Builder
public.description: input {rows,where?,orderBy?,offset?,limit?}; rows have common primitive-valued fields. where maps fields to exact primitives or one comparator object gt, lt, eq or in. Conditions are conjunctive. orderBy is one {key,direction:"asc" or "desc"}; sort stably, then skip offset rows and take limit rows. Return full rows. This is an executed JSON query plan, not a fluent API. At most 40 rows, nonnegative pagination. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.
